property_summary: For every caller/address and calldata, the reference C only allows the owner to successfully invoke sendMoney (calls succeed when tx.sender == owner); the mutant inverts the check so there exist inputs (owner as caller) where the reference allows the call but the mutant rejects it.
change_summary: Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender is NOT the owner, so only non-owners can call sendMoney, altering observable access behavior.
